content.query:
select SCHM_CODE SCHM_CODE2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT SCHM_CODE SCHM_CODE2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE WHERE SCHM_CODE='12005' AND  SRL_NUM='001'
UNION ALL
SELECT SCHM_CODE SCHM_CODE2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE WHERE SCHM_CODE='02010' AND  SRL_NUM='001'
UNION ALL
SELECT SCHM_CODE SCHM_CODE2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE WHERE SCHM_CODE='02505' AND  SRL_NUM='001'
UNION ALL
SELECT SCHM_CODE SCHM_CODE2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE WHERE SCHM_CODE='9999' AND  SRL_NUM='999' ) temp order by SCHM_CODE, SCD_START_DATE
